_comment: Canonical file edit wire shapes. FileEditRequest is the request for file editing operations. FileEditResult is the result. FileReadOptions and FileStats are sub-models. Serialized from FileEditRequest, FileEditResult, FileReadOptions, FileStats (internal/models/file_edit.go).

start_line.description: Starting line number (1-indexed). Omitted when zero.

end_line.description: Ending line number. Omitted when zero.

max_lines.description: Maximum lines to read. Omitted when zero.

is_symlink.description: Whether the file is a symlink

symlink_target.description: Symlink target path. Omitted when not a symlink.

file_edit_request._description: Request to perform file editing operations.

read_options.description: Read options. Conforms to file_read_options shape. Omitted when not set.

content.description: Full file content for write operations. Omitted when empty.

old_content.description: Old content for replace operations. Omitted when empty.

new_content.description: New content for replace operations. Omitted when empty.

insert_position.description: Line position for insert operations. Omitted when zero.

insert_content.description: Content to insert. Omitted when empty.

start_line.description: Start line for line-range operations. Omitted when zero.

end_line.description: End line for line-range operations. Omitted when zero.

patch_content.description: Patch content for patch operations. Omitted when empty.

create_backup.description: Whether to create a backup before editing

create_if_missing.description: Whether to create the file if it does not exist

file_edit_result._description: Result of a file editing operation.

status.description: Execution status. Values: EXECUTION_STATUS_EXECUTING, EXECUTION_STATUS_COMPLETED, EXECUTION_STATUS_FAILED.

content.description: Resulting file content (for read operations). Omitted when empty.

backup_path.description: Backup file path. Omitted when empty.

file_stats.description: File statistics. Conforms to file_stats shape. Omitted when not set.

lines_changed.description: Number of lines changed. Omitted when zero.

start_time.description: Operation start time. Omitted when zero.

end_time.description: Operation end time. Omitted when zero.

system_info.description: Execution system info. Conforms to terminal_output.json#execution_system_info. Omitted when not set.

environment_info.description: Execution environment info. Conforms to terminal_output.json#execution_environment_info. Omitted when not set.
